1: # Complementary Spec 18 recovery reconciliation
2: 
3: ## Scope and source identities
4: 
5: This candidate reconciles the complementary recovery behavior in two already published
6: branches. It does not replace their source-pinned evidence with a claim that this combined
7: candidate passed the same checks.
8: 
9: | Input | Source | Decision |
10: | --- | --- | --- |
11: | PR #238 | `198aa5baff22272453733a0f3dcfcac0e0994eec` | Existing consolidation ancestry retained through #239. |
12: | PR #239 | `4a1b181c89e02ee564b5568d4b4b8d689f5e42c5` | Base: retain atomic session replacement, generated-ciphertext retry, verification state invalidation, and deterministic real-crypto synchronization. |
13: | PR #240 | `38d69832ddc58ec27a19c00dbe3c89347c577495` | Recover BOM-byte refusals, event-time before-unload custody checks, and complementary browser acceptance cases. |
14: | Focused BOM source | `032c42fc3d5e52d8428a7907775835b5d1ed3704` | Source of the strict ASCII-byte checks and actual-file regressions. |
15: | Ownership claim | `a848be30` | New isolated branch `integration/ghostpay-recovery-reconciled-20261119`; both source branches remain unchanged. |
16: | Reconciled product/test commit | `3110611e4a49d2b3f426fc0b770a0823109ac3d4` | Nine web files changed; no dependency, contract, gate, or deployment changes. |
17: 
18: The source PR heads were reread from GitHub before editing. Main was observed at
19: `e454de6abfefda70d82784fafc1d8949b277c334` when this lane was assigned. The root
20: coordinator owns any later publication, main reconciliation, required CI and merge.
21: 
22: The root published the reviewed product candidate as draft
23: [PR #260](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/GhostPay/pull/260), stacked on #239.
24: GitHub Git Data API publication preserves the exact local trees:
25: 
26: | Local commit | Published commit | Identical complete tree |
27: | --- | --- | --- |
28: | `a848be30` | `1b76c84622f61ad5638856608f8c0d5ae606b425` | `fe247c5bdbda23dcf8e33025ba0db0b5e88ee31d` |
29: | `3110611e4a49d2b3f426fc0b770a0823109ac3d4` | `789e63501c1628d602006dbd324a36f8a9c50d71` | `e8c79567504010c91d86655711899e1751133498` |
30: 
31: This publication does not merge the unqualified #238/#239 ancestors into main. It
32: starts the source candidate's hosted checks while local validation proceeds.
33: 
34: ## Recovered behavior
35: 
36: `File.text()` removes a UTF-8 byte-order mark. Previously, a modified file could be
37: accepted after normalization even though the independent strict decoder rejected its
38: bytes. Recovery now requires the selected file's byte length to equal its ASCII text
39: length before opening or verifying. Saved-download verification requires both the
40: expected ASCII byte count and exact generated text. The portable codec continues to
41: reject other invalid characters and malformed data. The checks happen before the KDF.
42: 
43: The before-unload handler now applies to every loaded session. At the event it checks
44: whether keys are still loaded and whether a complete external copy is verified. A
45: browser-local vault alone does not suppress the warning: another tab could delete that
46: vault without updating this tab's cached custody summary. External-copy verification
47: is read at the event even when it did not change the cached React summary.
48: 
49: The #239 retry panel remains intact. A blocked download keeps its generated ciphertext,
50: and retrying does not repeat key derivation or export. Verification still becomes stale
51: after a passphrase edit. Replacement still stages all keys before clearing the existing
52: session. The sealing-barrier test and real-KDF promise observers remain intact.
53: 
54: ## Acceptance coverage
55: 
56: The combined test changes retain existing assertions and add or recover:
57: 
58: - Actual BOM bytes rejected by both recovery actions before keys can be installed or
59:   marked verified; existing wallet identity and custody remain unchanged.
60: - BOM-prefixed saved downloads rejected before verification or backup-success status.
61: - Cross-tab local-vault deletion still triggers an unload warning.
62: - Newly verified external backups immediately suppress that warning, even without a
63:   changed cached custody summary; a newly generated invoice-signing key still needs
64:   its own recoverable copy.
65: - Full/lean browser cases for real BOM files, master restoration with renewed
